import sys

def main():
    tokens = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not tokens:
        return
    n = int(tokens[0])
    nums = [int(x) for x in tokens[1:n+1]]
    nums.reverse()
    print(" ".join(map(str, nums)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
